title: Chitosan-modified biochar enhanced PFAS degradation in UV/sulfite: impact of environmental conditions and applicability across different PFAS
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00661A, Paper
Ziteng Song, Jianzhou He, Steven Mai, Thorsten Knappenberger, Yaniv Olshansky
Chi-BC significantly enhanced PFAS degradation in UV/sulfite systems, achieving defluorination rates up to 80%. The system maintains high efficiency even in a complex aqueous solution matrix including NOM, increased ionic strength, and nitrate.
